with q as (select l.link_id, s.issue_key sk, t.issue_key tk, s.assignee_key sa, t.assignee_key ta from model.issue_link l join model.issue s on s.issue_key = case when l.inward_label='supersedes' and l.link_type_name='Supersession' then l.to_issue_key else l.from_issue_key end join model.issue t on t.issue_key = case when l.inward_label='supersedes' and l.link_type_name='Supersession' then l.from_issue_key else l.to_issue_key end where (l.outward_label in ('blocks','depends on','duplicates') or l.inward_label='supersedes') and s.assignee_key is not null and t.assignee_key is not null and s.assignee_key<>'' and t.assignee_key<>'' and s.assignee_key<>t.assignee_key and not (l.inward_label='supersedes' and l.outward_label in ('blocks','depends on','duplicates')))
select distinct x.k as id, 'person' kind from q, lateral (values (sa),(ta)) x(k) where false
union all select distinct sa,'ans' from q
